meta.resolved: Values written with color-mix() or calc() in the source are resolved at the default contrast setting of 50; each such token says so in its usage note.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground of the staff workspace (Portal, Admin, PlanerLink, InfraLink, KursLink admin).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `sidebar-accent` (15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.usage: Content surfaces: cards, form sections, the sidebar, header and popovers.
